meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein dark spots aur dull skin ke liye Vitamin C serum choose karte waqt yeh dekhna zaroori hai ki usme stable Vitamin C derivative (jaise **3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid**) ho, jo jaldi oxidize nahi hota aur Indian skin par gentle rehta hai.

Aapke liye kuch best options yahan hain:

The Minimalist 10% Vitamin C Face Serum is great for beginners, featuring **stabilized vitamin C** and centella water to **fade dark spots** while gently boosting daily radiance.

The Plum 15% Vitamin C Face Serum With Mandarin uses ethyl ascorbic acid and kakadu plum to **reduce stubborn pigmentation** and **revive dull skin** with a lightweight, fragrance-free formula.

The Garnier Vitamin C + Face Serum combines vitamin C with **2% niacinamide** to **fight dark spots** and instantly refresh tired skin using a fast-absorbing texture.

The Chemist At Play 10% Vitamin C Face Serum features a **ceramide-infused base** to protect the skin barrier while **improving uneven tone** and overall radiance.

### Tips for Best Results:[ibacosmetics.com](https://ibacosmetics.com/blogs/iba-blogs/best-vitamin-c-serums-dermatologist-recommended#:~:text=Pair%20it%20with%20SPF%2050%20sunscreen%20every,Keep%20it%20in%20a%20cool%2C%20dark%20place.)

* **For Beginners:[deyga.in](https://deyga.in/blogs/news/best-vitamin-c-serum-recommended-by-dermatologist#:~:text=%28in%20some%20variants%29%20%7C%20%E2%82%B9669%20%7C%20Beginners%2C,Stable%2C%20non-irritating%20C%20for%20regular%20use%20%7C)** Agar aap pehli baar use kar rahe hain, toh **10% concentration** se start karein taaki skin irritate na ho.
* **Sunscreen is Must:** Subah Vitamin C lagane ke baad **SPF 50 sunscreen** zaroor lagayein, nahi toh dhoop se spots aur dark ho sakte hain.
